feature: Sisa persiapan upload dokumen court di staff portal: label 'Court Upload Documents', aturan file court_upload_doc (10 MB, Document), tipe Icourtcase (doc_type, file_name, b_lob, send_to_sc_flag)
note: Hanya definisi (label, konstanta validasi, tipe TypeScript); tidak ada komponen, route, atau endpoint yang memakainya (grep court_upload_doc, court_upload, doc_type di ocmsadminui/src: tidak ada pemakai). Bukan fitur yang bisa diklaim.
note_en: Definitions only (label, validation constant, TypeScript type); no component, route or endpoint uses them (grep court_upload_doc, court_upload, doc_type in ocmsadminui/src: no user). Not a claimable feature.

feature: Placeholder menu laporan court (Vault, Submit, Summon, Rejected) dengan path kosong dan resource courtcasesummary dikomentari
note: Empat entri court di menu Report tanpa halaman (path "") dan tanpa backend; bukan laporan dokumen ter-upload. Tiket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) menyebut 'new court reports' akan datang.
note_en: Four court entries in the Report menu with no page (path "") and no backend; not a report of uploaded documents. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-194 (Open) mentions 'new court reports' coming.

feature: Filter Notice Search by court mention date / court trial date / warrant no / summon no memanggil endpoint courtmention, courttrial, warrantofarrest, summon yang tidak punya backend di repo
note: UI memanggil endpoint tersebut dan api-authorization.properties:23 mendaftarkan path /v1/courtmention, /v1/courttrial, /v1/warrantofarrest, /v1/summon, tetapi tidak ada controller untuk path itu di ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi. Pencarian summon hanya aktif jika isAPIFound (staging/local). Cannot verify from repo apakah backend ada di layanan lain.
note_en: The UI calls these endpoints and api-authorization.properties:23 lists the paths /v1/courtmention, /v1/courttrial, /v1/warrantofarrest, /v1/summon, but no controller for those paths exists in ocmsadminapi, ocmsadminprivateapi, thirdpartyapi. Summons search runs only when isAPIFound (staging/local). Cannot verify from repo whether the backend exists in another service.

feature: Grid 'Court Application History' di tab History notice (resource courtcase) yang hanya aktif di STAGING/LOCAL
note: Stub baca-saja untuk riwayat aplikasi court per notice; resource kosong jika bukan STAGING/LOCAL, endpoint courtcase tidak punya controller di ocmsadminapi, dan kolomnya (complaint_no, batch_status) tidak ada di entity OcmsCourtCase. Bukan halaman detail court untuk upload dokumen.
note_en: Read-only stub for court application history per notice; the resource is empty outside STAGING/LOCAL, the courtcase endpoint has no controller in ocmsadminapi, and its columns (complaint_no, batch_status) are not in the OcmsCourtCase entity. Not a court detail page for document upload.
